title: At the Bus Stand
speaker: Bus Conductor
question: “ಯಾವ ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ಬೇಕು?” (Where do you need to go?)
context: You are at the bus terminal and need to confirm if this bus is heading to Mysuru.
prompt: Which Kannada response politely asks if this bus goes to Mysuru?

options.why: Correct! This directly and politely checks if the bus goes to Mysuru before boarding.
This means “Please give me one hot filter coffee.” This is used at a café, not on a bus.
This means “Thank you.” While polite, it does not communicate your destination.

title: Finding Your Way
speaker: Local Resident
question: “ಹೇಳಿ, ಏನಾಗಬೇಕಿತ್ತು?” (Yes, what do you need?)
context: You are standing at an unfamiliar junction and need to locate the nearest bus stop.
prompt: Choose the phrase that asks for the location of the bus stop.

options.why: This means “I want this.” Use this when pointing to goods in a store.
Spot on! “ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ?” means “Where is the bus stop?”
This means “Water, please.” Useful in eateries, not for navigation.

title: At the Local Darshini
speaker: Café Counter Attendant
question: “ಏನ್ ಬೇಕು ಸರ್/ಮೇಡಂ?” (What would you like, Sir/Madam?)
context: You want to order a fresh South Indian filter coffee in the morning.
prompt: Which phrase correctly requests a hot filter coffee?

options.why: Perfect! “ಒಂದು ಬಿಸಿ ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್ ಕಾಫಿ ಕೊಡಿ” orders one hot filter coffee.
This asks where the bus stop is.
This means “Please help me.” It is overly dramatic for placing an order.

title: At the Market Stall
speaker: Vendor
question: “ಇದು ತುಂಬಾ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟದ್ದು.” (This is very high quality.)
context: You are looking at handicrafts or vegetables and want to know the price.
prompt: Choose the standard phrase to ask how much it costs.

options.why: Correct! “ಇದರ ಬೆಲೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?” means “How much does this cost?”
This means “Please stop here.” Useful in an auto or cab.

title: Negotiating at the Bazaar
speaker: Fruit Seller
question: “ಒಂದು ಕೆ.ಜಿಗೆ ನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ.” (One hundred rupees per kilo.)
context: You feel the price is slightly steep and want to politely ask if a discount is possible.
prompt: Which phrase politely negotiates a slight price reduction?

options.why: Courteous and effective! “ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಾ?” asks if the price can be reduced a little.
This means “Make it less spicy” for food preparations.
This asks where the nearest hospital is.

title: Clinic Assistance
speaker: Clinic Receptionist
question: “ಹಲೋ, ಏನು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ?” (Hello, what seems to be the trouble?)
context: You are feeling unwell and need to ask whether the doctor is currently available.
prompt: Which phrase respectfully explains you are unwell and asks for the doctor?

options.why: Accurate and polite! It communicates that you are unwell and asks if the doctor is in.
This means “Do you have another colour?” used when shopping.
This asks when the meeting starts in a workplace context.
